title: ChronEpisode — canonical temporal episode object
description: Every CHRON cycle produces one ChronEpisode. The Telegram output, PNG, PDF, voice, dashboard, or silence is DERIVED from this object — not the other way around. Derived from: CHRON-TEMPORAL-SUBSTRATE-ARCHITECTURE.md §3, chron_events.json schema, chron_spine_gate.py nine-arrow structure, alpha_zen_engine.py signal pools.
status: DESIGN — v1, not yet wired to runtime
DESIGN_PRINCIPLES: Episode identity is the primary key. Everything else is a property of the episode.
Four distinct clocks: valid_time (when reality happened), observed_at (when sensor saw it), known_at (when institution accepted it), relevance_time (when it mattered to this principal).
Observations are raw sensor output. Claims are epistemic assertions about observations. Predictions are future commitments with verify_at.
Selected and rejected signals are both recorded — rejected signals enable negative-space learning.
Privacy scope is per-episode, not per-field. An episode is PRIVATE or SHARED.
Parent episode IDs enable causal lineage tracking across cycles.
The episode is append-only. Corrections use supersedes, never rewrites.

episode_id.description: Canonical episode ID. Format: chron-ep-{YYYYMMDD}-{function}-{hash8}. Content-addressed from body.

cycle_id.description: Which CHRON cycle produced this episode. Links to cron execution ID.

parent_episode_ids.description: Causal lineage. Episodes that this one responds to, supersedes, or continues.

function.description: Position in the CHRON causal spine. Determines what fields are required and what the episode means.

question.description: The question this episode answers. E.g. 'What changed?', 'What do we expect?', 'Were we right?'

principal.description: Who this episode is about or for.

audience.description: Who may see the derived output.

valid_time.description: When reality happened (event time). ISO-8601 UTC.

observed_at.description: When the sensor saw it. ISO-8601 UTC.

known_at.description: When the institution accepted it. ISO-8601 UTC.

relevance_time.description: When it mattered to this principal. ISO-8601 UTC.

expires_at.description: When this episode's derived output should stop being shown.

source.description: Where this observation came from (organ, feed, sensor).

observations.description: Raw sensor output. Truth class is mandatory.

basis.description: Non-authoritative basis. Authoritative basis is provenance.

supersedes.description: claim_id of the claim this replaces.

claims.description: Epistemic assertions about observations. Truth state is mandatory.

selected_signals.description: Signals that were selected for attention. Ranked by urgency × consequence × actionability.

rejected_signals.description: Signals that were considered but rejected. Enables negative-space learning: which rejected signals became consequential?

predictions.description: Future commitments with verification appointments. Empty until Phase 3.

error_class.description: Classification of why prediction differed from outcome.

output_decision.description: Whether this episode produces visible output. SILENT is an intelligent action.

renderer_used.description: What renderer was used for the derived output. 'none' if SILENT.

source_ref.description: Pointer to source (URL, organ endpoint, file path).

receipts.description: Receipt IDs from arifFlow, VAULT999, or A-FORGE that attest to this episode's claims.

supersedes_episode_id.description: If this episode corrects a previous one, the episode_id being corrected.

superseded_by_episode_id.description: If a later episode corrected this one, that episode_id.

PredictionNode.description: A prediction is a future commitment with a verification appointment. Without verify_at, no verification can occur. Without verification, no calibration can accumulate.

verify_at.description: When this prediction must be checked against reality. CRITICAL: without this, the prediction floats forever.

assumptions.description: What must hold for this prediction to be correct.

brier_score.description: Calibration score after verification. Only set after status is VERIFIED_*.
